info.name: Amazon Connect Service Agent Statuses Metrics API
Amazon Connect Get Historical Metric Data

params.name: InstanceId
params.description: The identifier of the Amazon Connect instance.

items.docs: Gets historical metric data from the specified Amazon Connect instance. You can use this API to get historical data for Amazon Connect queues, routing profiles, agents, and contact flows.

info.name: Amazon Connect Get Current Metric Data

params.name: InstanceId
params.description: The identifier of the Amazon Connect instance.

items.docs: Gets the real-time metric data from the specified Amazon Connect instance. For a description of each metric, see Real-time Metrics Definitions in the Amazon Connect Administrator Guide.
